_comment: EXAMPLE D6 app-auth config — PLACEHOLDERS ONLY, fail-closed default. Copy to auth.config.local.json (GIT-IGNORED via *.local.json) only AFTER the D6 admin setup exists (see docs/D6_AUTH_APP_REGISTRATION_PLAN.md + docs/D6_ADMIN_EXECUTION_CHECKLIST.md). All values are REFERENCES: tenant/client ids are entered at runtime and the certificate is referenced by CurrentUser store thumbprint (store:CurrentUser/My/<thumbprint>) — the private key stays in the Windows certificate store; no secret, key, or token is ever placed in a config file. Validation (d6AuthConfig.js) refuses placeholders, secret-style keys, inline key material, malformed store refs, and legacy/production-looking targets. apiMode: 'graph' works with the Graph-resource Sites.Selected consent (Hyperlink columns are NOT writable — platform limitation; default behavior 'refuse'); 'sharepoint-rest' has full column fidelity but requires the SHAREPOINT-resource Sites.Selected application permission to be consented as well.
